convention_correction.issue: Earlier derived models treated spreadsheet off-diagonals as tensor entries. They are signed CONM2 products and must be negated in the tensor.
convention_correction.proof: Only the corrected convention reproduces all36 entries of the original Nastran rigid-body MO matrix within its printed precision for both skins.

publication.load_convention: SectionIV.B: midchord bending load; torsion load0.04m/0.08m behind trailing edge for skin off/on. Remove zero-payload gravity displacement AND twist from sweep comparisons.
publication.limitations: SectionIV.A suggests imperfect experimental in-plane clamping and discusses skin-stretch effects absent from constant-stiffness beams. These explanations are not independently proved here.

limitations: K12 intrinsic extension-torsion is still explicitly projected; this audit does not remove that constitutive limitation.
Static load and observation geometry use the nominal0.1m chord and paper reference-axis fraction. Original UM/NAST load-input coordinates are not provided in this dataset.
Reference-axis nodes are shifted from the GFEM origin. Structural mesh edges and the nominal aerodynamic outline need not coincide; exact experimental fixture geometry remains unresolved.
The six original ISAE out-of-domain attachments are not repaired or validated by these generated inputs.
No added10g/5g calibration mass is appended: primary inertia totals already include the original GFEM concentrated masses. Only requested bench payload is added.
